title: Modi-Prabowo sextet of good intentions
description: The Modi-Prabowo summit is a shared commitment to enhance strategic cooperation between two major Asian powers. This is necessitated by the dominance of China and the weakening U.S. pledges to regional security. Bilaterally, there has been political progress but limited economic engagement. The key now is to step up the trade and investment pillar, with energetic follow-up action for a strong trajectory. The post Modi-Prabowo sextet of good intentions appeared first on Gateway House.
